findings.text: Blanking a finding's path now reads as repository-scoped. With a root known, runs._repository_relative_scope('', root) returns '.' (Path('') resolves to the root itself), so _record_rows gives path '.' and _scope_of 'repository', where the retired findings._repository_relative returned None and the row was path '' with scope 'artefact'. Measured through _record_rows at head 2f2682e44 (module /home/ITER/mcintos/Code/.reckon-worktrees/reckon-c8f839407e49/health-review-1010/findings-uses-the-scope-owner/reckon/crew/findings.py): a finding with no path key -> path '.' scope 'repository'; at base 611ad57d the same finding -> path '' scope 'artefact'. An absolute path equal to the root shifts the same way (base '' / artefact; head '.' / repository). The new absent-root branch guards the empty path; the rooted branch does not, so findings' deliberate artefact classification for a pathless finding is lost. No test covers a pathless finding, so the suite stays green through the change.
